_about: The scatter rules of the generated land (src/core/gen/scatter.js). props: the things that stand on the land, in this order (an earlier kind takes its cells first). prop: the kind (src/world/props/; a log by a road is low enough to jump over). spacing: no two of a kind are nearer than this (cells; local samples by a seeded priority of each cell, never a grid). size: the footprint (cells). chance: the part of the samples that stay. patch: a noise that makes groves (scale in cells; a sample stays where the noise is over `over`, from -1 to 1; key: the name of the noise, so that two rules can have different noises). top: a range of steps under the highest cell within 6 cells (0 is a top). The forest of the hills (over the low land: level): groves of bamboo where a noise lets them (patch), trees with clearings where a noise leaves open land, crowns of three sizes (crowns: the radius of the crown in fine blocks, one of the list by the seed), rocks, and open grass with a few rocks near the tops (top), and rocks on the rock faces (r). The rules of a cell (each a range [from, to]): level (the height in steps), water (cells to the nearest water), road (cells to the nearest road), field (cells to the nearest paddy). on: the ground letters (see the legend of the maps). life: groups of living things (kind in data/world/life.json, n: from and to, r: the radius in cells), with the same rules. margin: cells from the edge of a map with nothing on them, so that the edges stay open. hamlets: small hamlets of two or three houses (src/core/gen/hamlets.js): spacing (no two hamlets nearer, in cells), road (cells from the door of the yard to the road), water (cells to water), chance (the part of the good places that get a hamlet). A size can be [w, h] (a boat on a bank).
